reason: I'd screenshot that paper cloud pendant, run it through Google Lens and find a near-identical one on Amazon or AliExpress for a fraction of $360. I've never heard of this store, and there's no trade pricing, so I'd just buy the cheaper one on Prime.
objection: I can't judge the quality from photos, and nothing here shows me why this one is worth more than the lookalikes I can get for $100 to $150 with two-day Prime shipping. A new store with almost no reviews and a 2 to 3 week wait doesn't help.
would_change_my_mind: A trade or designer discount (15 to 20% off), or a $10 to $15 physical sample or swatch of the paper and fixture finish shipped to me before I commit to the full price.
